Thanks Liam — confirmed receipt and appreciate the proposed window. High level reply and next steps below.

Key points:
- Scope: OS micro-updates + runtime lib bump only; no model or config changes.
- Rollback: automatic canary fail => immediate stop of rollout, rollback to prior container image + KV-cache invalidation for canary nodes, then traffic drainer to routed-hosted variant for affected customers for up to 15m while we investigate.
- SLA concession: we can authorize a temporary latency SLO easing (p50/p95 increases tolerated) for the two canary slices and up to 30 minutes of rollback traffic while forensics run. We will need CentricHealth signoff for any longer concession.

I attached our internal checklist (redwood_patch_safety_checklist.pdf) and the last canary metrics (canary-metrics-20251129.csv).

Action items for this thread:
1) Karthik: publish the exact canary node list and the image tag we will use.
2) Connor: confirm monitoring/alert thresholds and the on-call playbook to trigger automatic rollback.
3) Liam: confirm you are ok with the 02:00-06:00 ET window and the SLA concession for the slices.

I'll schedule a brief ops call tomorrow to walk through the step-by-step.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Sofia / team — planning notes and image tags below.

Planned image tag: redwood/runtime:v2025.11.2-micro
Canary nodes (US-east racks): eu1-rack-07-canary, eu1-rack-08-canary (these are isolated & drainable).
Rollback gates (automatic):
- Canary qps drop > 20% sustained for 3m OR
- Error rate increase > 2% absolute OR
- Latency p95 increase > 250ms absolute compared to baseline

If gate trips:
1) Orchestrator stops roll and reverts the canary nodes to previous image.
2) KV cache invalidation on those nodes.
3) Routing policy switches affected customers to hosted fallback (per configured routing list) for up to 15m while we run a fast postmortem.

Notes/asks:
- We need CentricHealth to confirm which customer tenant IDs must never be routed off-prem (if any); that will modify the routing step.
- Connor: need the list of alert channels and the playbook pointer (ticket create + on-call pager).

-Karthik
